items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public beta or full launch of the gated product; conditional for ordinary reversible fleet growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, platform-policy, affiliate, and data-handling boundaries. Exact decision: keep the gated product private, keep external outreach unsent, authorize no rights-dependent monetization, tracking expansion, alert expansion, or regulated/age-sensitive scope expansion. Evidence: upstream API documentation establishes access mechanics but not storage, derivatives, public display, caching, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark/image/price use, affiliate, or advertising rights; current public terms point against the proposed commercial/public use. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 37 pass, 15 fail, 7 unknown, with open banner, consent, analytics, privacy, and terms findings. Analytics has permission errors for some properties; revenue is limited to a 2026-09-21 aggregate commission of $4.92 that is not site-attributable; security, accuracy/freshness, attribution, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, and any future affiliate or advertising use. Ordinary growth is not blocked solely by incomplete telemetry, but no retained change may expand data collection, monetization, claims, external sharing, or platform exposure without site-specific evidence.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks closed and 4 remain open. No task is closed because current evidence is partial. Open tasks are source rights; alert-data flow and retention; GA4 consent and configuration; and logs, vendors, and incident handling. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage/display/alerts, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures. Do not send outreach, change the private gate, enable tracking, expand alerts, or expand monetization.

Data-use dispositions: upstream API deal and price-history data is counsel_required and launch-blocked; user alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed; GA4 analytics is evidence_needed; operational logs and hosting data are evidence_needed. No item is clear or conditionally launchable on current evidence. Smallest next actions: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review; produce the repository and deployed data-flow and retention table; capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking or advertising; and produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory covering log fields, retention, access, incident, and data-request procedures.

Compliance, data quality, site, analytics, and revenue review: retain the technical compliance baseline as evidence only, not certification. The latest baseline reports 37 passing, 15 failing, and 7 unknown sites with open banner, consent, analytics, privacy, and terms findings. Analytics is broadly available but has source permission errors and yellow freshness/coverage status; do not treat failed sources as zero. Revenue is period-limited and partially aggregate: $4.92 is not site-attributable, so ROI, margin, payback, and monetization claims remain unsupported. Parked or unreachable sites require a concrete retain-parked or bounded-launch decision and a completed site-specific checklist before exposure or monetization. No go-live proposal is supported.
